canonical_statement: Gauge-equivalence classes of anti-self-dual connections on an appropriate four-dimensional space correspond to isomorphism classes of holomorphic vector bundles on its twistor space satisfying the relevant reality condition and whose restrictions to the corresponding twistor lines are holomorphically trivial.
domain_and_universes: Not frozen: the base four-manifold/compactification, gauge group or structure group, bundle regularity, and twistor-space model must be selected in the statement phase.
quantifiers: a permitted anti-self-dual connection modulo the selected gauge equivalence
a permitted holomorphic bundle on the associated twistor space modulo holomorphic isomorphism
hypotheses: holomorphic triviality on each relevant twistor line
a reality condition compatible with the selected real form
regularity, topology, and framing/decay assumptions required by the selected variant
conclusion: The direct and inverse Ward transforms are well-defined on equivalence classes and mutually inverse.
excluded_claims: the generic word 'Ward correspondence' without a fixed geometric setting
the Ward-Takahashi identity from quantum field theory
an experimental or physical assertion not reduced to geometric definitions
a merely injective or surjective transform presented as the full correspondence

alternate_encodings.target: Euclidean R^4 / compactified S^4 instanton correspondence
complex anti-self-dual Yang-Mills correspondence on complexified spacetime

degenerate_and_boundary_cases: Reducible connections, nontrivial splitting type on twistor lines, singular bundles, noncompact decay conditions, and charge-zero objects require explicit treatment; none is silently included or excluded at intake.
foundation_profile: Uninstantiated: expected differential/complex geometry, quotient-by-equivalence, and possible classical-choice obligations remain to be audited.
tcb_profile: Lean 4 kernel with pinned mathlib; exact toolchain and dependency closure remain open.
computation_profile: No computation, numerical evidence, or oracle is credited at intake.
source_revisions: Discovery sources and unresolved pin/errata work are recorded in source_statement_crosswalk.md.
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on changes to the chosen Ward variant, geometric domains, equivalence relations, Lean target, imports/toolchain, source pins, or rev-5.6 standard.
status_boundary: This planned intake identifies the theorem family and its unresolved choices. It does not freeze an exact Lean proposition, verify a correspondence, or inherit the untrusted source label.
